title: J. Storrs Hall's utility fog

tellings.quote: In 1989, scientist Dr. J. Storrs Hall >> [music] pitched the concept of utility fog, an active polymorphic material made up of trillions of foglets

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a scientist named J. Storrs Hall who, in 1989, pitched an idea he called utility fog. According to Michels, it was a shape-shifting material made of trillions of tiny machines called foglets that could act together. Michels raises it because such a material, if real, could explain objects that seem to change shape.
